cases.name: coverage_tokenizer_vocab_file
cases.coverage_note: Local WordPiece fixture exercises vocab_file forwarding without relying on the legacy BertWordPieceLowerCase alias's remote bert-large-uncased metadata.

cases.name: coverage_checkpoint_local_config
cases.coverage_note: Requires nvidia-resiliency-ext local checkpoint imports. Configuration only, no local checkpoint save/recovery claim.

cases.name: coverage_scheduler_resume_checkpoint_policy
cases.coverage_note: Current-run constructor inputs plus checkpoint-selected scheduler restoration; no --use-checkpoint-args. Keep max/min LR equal to the seed because optimizer checkpoint group keys include those values; vary decay style instead.

cases.name: coverage_validation_full
cases.coverage_note: Configuration only: full validation over the default mock corpus is not a bounded smoke run. A tiny real indexed-data fixture is needed for runtime coverage.

cases.name: coverage_validation_only_config
cases.coverage_note: Configuration only: builder does not claim evaluation-only control-flow coverage.

cases.name: coverage_validation_multiple_config
cases.coverage_note: Blend/config construction only; these symbolic dataset prefixes are not opened. No multi-dataset evaluation claim.

cases.name: coverage_train_signal_duration_config
cases.coverage_note: Configuration/handler setup only. Does not send signals, wait for a time limit, or run performance sniff tests.

cases.name: coverage_optimizer_muon_layout_config
cases.coverage_note: Validation derives use_layer_wise_distributed_optimizer; it is not a raw CLI flag. No Muon training claim.

cases.name: coverage_optimizer_graph_config
cases.coverage_note: Configuration only; does not claim CUDA graph capture/replay.

cases.name: coverage_fsdp_registration_config
cases.coverage_note: Config/validation only, not FSDP or userbuffer construction.

cases.name: coverage_fsdp2_reshard_config
cases.coverage_note: Config/validation only, including the derived FSDP2 reshard policy; actual FSDP execution remains untested.

cases.name: coverage_dataset_cache_config
cases.coverage_note: Config only with mock data; no cache-file reuse, object-storage I/O, or mmap behavior claim.

cases.name: coverage_dataset_inter_document_config
cases.coverage_note: Config only, not packed-kernel execution.

cases.name: coverage_dataset_fim_config
cases.coverage_note: FIM config capture only with a symbolic indexed-data prefix. No file loading or FIM augmentation is executed.

cases.name: coverage_logger_disabled_service_metadata
cases.coverage_note: Dormant metadata only: one-logger disabled, W&B project unset, OTel disabled. No external-service coverage claimed.

cases.name: coverage_logger_moe_trace
cases.coverage_note: Existing tiny MoE topology is only a prerequisite for logger coverage.

cases.name: coverage_checkpoint_async_worker
cases.coverage_note: Requires the matching nvidia-resiliency-ext async implementation. Save-hook completion alone does not prove durable async completion.

cases.name: coverage_checkpoint_cache_config
cases.coverage_note: Configuration only; no cache reuse or checkpoint conversion. CLI-only worker/drop controls need later consumer capture.

cases.name: coverage_checkpoint_debug_intervals_config
cases.coverage_note: Debug-dump configuration only, no tensor/activation dump behavior claim.

cases.name: coverage_profiling_chakra_config
cases.coverage_note: Chakra configuration only; execution requires optional Chakra dependencies.
